title: Weekly Vessel Valuations Report, September 15 2026
summary:
Main
Bulkers
Handysize bulker values firmed at the older end of the curve this week, while Capesize, Panamax, Supramaxand the younger Handysize bands remained in a stable range. Capesize Erato (180,100 DWT, Feb 2010) sold to an undisclosed South Korean buyer for USD 36.75 mil, VV Value USD 35.71 mil. Panamax KM MT Jade (81,200 DWT, Oct 2008) sold to an undisclosed Chinese buyer for USD 16.0 mil, VV Value USD 15.69 mil.
